messages.subject: Typo in error message
parts:
Yves, just letting you know that the error message

In Nvcov.first.order(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING: matrix based on first order outer product of the derivatives is not positive definite; the standard errors may not be thrustworthy

contains a mistake ("thrustworthy" for "trustworthy").

Regards,
Mark
